info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Consumer Currency Exchange Lookup API provides users with the capability to retrieve real-time currency exchange rates based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows businesses and developers to fetch exchange rate information for various currencies using a dynamic parameter. Typical consumers include finance applications, banking services, and e-commerce platforms seeking accurate and timely currency conversion data. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their applications with reliable currency exchange information tailored to their specific needs.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a currency exchange by resource ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch detailed information about a specific currency exchange identified by its resource ID (RES-100045). It provides necessary data for further processing and understanding of the exchange parameters.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving currency exchange details for the specific consumer service. This body must be in JSON format and should conform to the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the exchange rate details are returned.
